summaries.n-gta6-launch-coins: Coins named for Grand Theft Auto VI, which Rockstar Games released on 2026-11-19 (it posted on 2025-11-06 that the game would release on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and on 2026-11-12 that it was one week away). Thirty-nine coins are members, thirty-six of them collected; each has GTA, GTA VI or a GTA VI place, character or in-game brand in its name or description: WASTED ("the iconic GTA death screen"), GTA6CAT, GTA Dollars, Ah shit, here we go again., gtacoin (LaunchLab), Macca The Gator ("GTA 6 Mascot"), State of Leonida and The State of Leonida, Peekhole ("a parody of OnlyFans inside GTA 6"), GTA memes, Jason Duval (it says holders earn $TTWO stock, which is not verified here), Rocco, EEAGLE, Doug The Frog, Jason & Lucia (it says it is unofficial), Official Grand Theft Auto VI (nothing shows it is official), GTA Vice Inu, Grand Trench Agency ("not affiliated with any game"), WANTED, Here We Go Again, Leonida Games, Grand Theft Anthropic, and coins named for BAWSAQ, the games' fictional stock exchange (Bawsaq, two Vice City Index coins, Vice City Bawsaq).
